source_confirmation_clause: The one-to-eighty subdivision of shares has become effective on March 1, 2021, immediately upon approval by the Company's shareholders. Concurrently on the same day, a change in the American depositary share ratio proportionate to the share subdivision from ten ADSs representing one Class A ordinary share to one ADS representing eight Class A ordinary shares has taken effect.
